issues: Recurring Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (also flagged in iteration_7). Pre-existing, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: StatementImportTab doPreview({}) hard-resets mapping on Preview click — a Re-apply Mapping button exists but the Preview button ignores current mapping (by design). Fine but non-obvious. Consider a single canonical 'Preview' that uses current mapping and a distinct 'Auto-detect' button.
BulkApproveBar.approve() uses window.confirm — same UX concern flagged in previous iteration. Consider a shadcn AlertDialog with data-testid for consistency.
ParsingTemplatesTab tpl-delete uses window.confirm — same pattern. Works but not testable via modal selectors.

StatementImportTab file-input is truly hidden (input.hidden). set_input_files needs to skip visibility check — worked with playwright but any automated tool asserting element visibility will fail. This is standard for shadcn upload pattern, no code change required.
DataMigration.jsx csv-file-input is also hidden — same as above.
